parameters.L,M,W: arbitrary functions from complex numbers to complex numbers

hypotheses: For every s with max a b < s.re: L s * M s = W s

primary_contract.coefficient_assumptions: None: no arithmetic coefficients, Dirichlet character, modulus, Euler product or Dirichlet series is fixed by this declaration.
primary_contract.nonvanishing: No nonvanishing hypothesis or conclusion in this declaration.

primary_contract.proof_mechanism: Anchor max a b + 1; initial equality gives full-neighborhood eventual equality there; convex target half-plane is preconnected; apply existing Mathlib analytic identity principle to the analytic product.
primary_contract.mathematical_role: Half-plane convenience specialization of an existing Mathlib identity theorem, not an arithmetic continuation supplier.
